title: 0.2.17 release readiness hardening
summary: This update continues release readiness work: embedded Python packaging and verified OTA metadata generation.
highlights: Release builds now include an embedded Python 3.11 runtime with openpyxl, so new machines do not depend on a user-installed Python.
The release pipeline writes SHA256, size, and URL metadata into UPDATE_NOTICE.json for the runtime zip.
Install-time Python checks now fail fast if the bundled runtime cannot import openpyxl.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
